scripts.build: pnpm --filter @libitums/ui-lynx build && pnpm --filter @libitums/mobile build && pnpm --filter @libitums/storybook-lynx build
scripts.bundle:host: pnpm build && cp apps/mobile/dist/main.lynx.bundle apps/ios/main.lynx.bundle && mkdir -p apps/ios/Resource/static && rsync -a --delete apps/mobile/dist/static/ apps/ios/Resource/static/
scripts.bundle:android: pnpm --filter @libitums/ui-lynx build && pnpm --filter @libitums/mobile build && node devtools/android-bundle/sync.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @libitums/ui-lynx typecheck && pnpm --filter @libitums/mobile typecheck && pnpm --filter @libitums/storybook-lynx typecheck && pnpm --filter @libitums/supabase-functions typecheck
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @libitums/ui-lynx test:unit && pnpm --filter @libitums/mobile test:unit && pnpm --filter @libitums/supabase-functions test:unit
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @libitums/ui-lynx test:integration && pnpm --filter @libitums/mobile test:integration && pnpm --filter @libitums/supabase-functions test:integration && pnpm --filter @libitums/storybook-lynx test
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:ui && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:report-policy && pnpm test:bundle-size && pnpm test:ci-wiring && pnpm test:ui-copy-literals && pnpm test:android-bundle
scripts.test:e2e:android: pnpm test:e2e:android:host && pnpm test:e2e:android:social && pnpm test:e2e:android:legal && pnpm test:e2e:android:small
scripts.lint: oxlint && pnpm lint:tokens && pnpm cycle:check && pnpm lint:ui-copy
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm size:check && pnpm performance:reports:gate
